title: test_librarian_trees rides the testing database, and its mark-and-clean code is deleted
intention: Once e4fd7f28faaf lands, test_librarian_trees.py writes nothing to the live tables by construction, so 784eb1e92866's run id, testing marker and finally-block deletes come out of it, and every tooth it proves stays.
why: Measured 2026-11-20: 784eb1e92866 PROVED (cairn 7ade65adb) with mark-and-clean in cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py (9cf8b7901: _RUN, a provenance testing marker, store.delete of nodes and embeddings). Outline 4.3.1.5.1.5.2 puts isolation in the runner by construction, not filtering in the proof, and its outline check on Windows missed the conflict. Code that the construction makes unneeded is deleted.
traces_to: Law 1 (a settled answer, the outline line, is not re-derived in each proof); Law 4 (the rule is physics in the runner, not policy in a proof).
how: Rides e4fd7f28faaf. In cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py: keep the per-run token _RUN in every node's content (cairn_testing is one shared schema and a node id is sha256(content), so the token is what keeps two concurrent copies' ids disjoint); delete the testing/run keys in _PROV, the _CREATED_NODES list and the store.delete calls in _cleanup, keeping every tooth and the cairn_threads reset the MAX_THREADS teeth need. cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees_runs_alongside_itself.py counts the live rows carrying each copy's token (nodes by content, embeddings and links joined by id); totals reported, never asserted (31ba1dd472d6's shape). A red-first proof cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees_rides_the_testing_database.py reads cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py's source for the mark-and-clean forms and runs it once, counting the live rows carrying its token.

clauses.claim: two copies of test_librarian_trees.py run at the same time both exit 0 with no FAIL tooth

across a run, the live rows it could have written are unchanged: the cairn_nodes whose content carries the run's token, and the cairn_embeddings and cairn_links that join to those nodes by id. The live totals are reported and never asserted, because another live writer moves them
one copy run alone exits 0 and proves every tooth name it proved at 7ade65adb
cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py carries no testing/run provenance key and no hand cleanup of node, embedding or link rows; isolation comes from a per-run token in content

decisions.text: D1: delete the mark-and-clean code from cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees.py (the testing and run provenance keys, _CREATED_NODES, the store.delete calls in _cleanup); the per-run token stays in content and every tooth stays.
D2: cairn/devices/librarian/proofs/test_librarian_trees_runs_alongside_itself.py counts the live rows carrying each copy's token, not totals; totals are reported and never asserted.
D3: a red-first proof, PROVES {2,3,4}; clause 1 is D2's proof.

D4 (a hypothesis, akiendelllinux_cc_orchestrator 2026-11-20, option (a)): a per-run token in content is enough isolation inside the one shared cairn_testing schema, so per-test-id schemas (a change to e4fd7f28faaf's door) are not cast now. Falsifier: two concurrent copies with identical inputs, tokens in place, both read green (clause 1). A collision with tokens in place is the measurement that casts per-test-id schemas as its own ticket.

out: e4fd7f28faaf's store door (cairn/devices/db_domain), its own ticket
the rows already in the live tables
the seven codemother proof tickets (their own)

measured.saw: 784eb1e92866 PROVED with mark-and-clean code in test_librarian_trees.py; outline 4.3.1.5.1.5.2 rules filtering out; akiendelllinux_cc_orchestrator ruled the outline stands and named this follow-up
with ONE token forced on two concurrent copies under a tester test id, copy 1 bit 6 teeth and copy 2 bit 8 (UniqueViolation cairn_embeddings_pkey; already-refuted retirements)
